WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as baseline_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(sg.rfistat, 'No Status') as status,
    sg.status_avg,
    sg.status_avg - b.baseline_avg as above_baseline
  FROM status_groups sg, baseline b
  WHERE sg.status_avg > b.baseline_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_kept_avg
  FROM above_baseline
)
SELECT 
  ab.status,
  ab.status_avg,
  ab.above_baseline,
  ab.status_avg - km.mean_kept_avg as diff_from_mean_kept
FROM above_baseline ab, kept_mean km
ORDER BY ab.status;

assumptions.assumption: NULL rfistat values are grouped as 'No Status' (their own group). The baseline is calculated from all signals with non-NULL modindex, regardless of rfistat. Group averages include only signals with non-NULL modindex. Filtering for 'above baseline' happens after these calculations.
